name: pg_living_assertions
abstract: A registry of things you claim are true, with the SQL that proves them and the date they were last proven
description: pg_living_assertions is a registry of guarantees about your database: each one declares what it claims, the SQL that proves it, who approved it, and when it was last checked with what result. Checks run read-only in a rolled-back subtransaction, and every verdict carries its age, because a stale "holds" reads exactly like a fresh one.

pg_living_assertions.abstract: Register what you believe is true, with the SQL that proves it and the date it was last proven
